user_query: trass gmail that mentions shipBob or merchant or support and doesnt mention mgm, limit query to last 3 weeks

intent.goal: find gmail messages in trass workspace containing shipBob, merchant or support, excluding mgm

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    g.subject,
    g.sender_name,
    g.sender_email,
    g.body_snippet
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%shipBob%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%shipBob%' OR
    g.subject LIKE '%merchant%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%merchant%' OR
    g.subject LIKE '%support%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%support%'
)
AND g.subject NOT LIKE '%mgm%'
AND g.message_content NOT LIKE '%mgm%'
AND u.created_time >= date('now', '-21 days')
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200
